summary: Feature implemented in the repository, but nothing has been executed. Added monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver), an engine-free plot_2d_or_3d_image in monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py, and changed write_nifti's default dtype to np.float32. SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver and TensorBoardImageHandler are now thin adapters over these. Renamed output_path to output_dir in tests/integration_sliding_window.py and the two unet_evaluation examples. Added tests/test_csv_saver.py, tests/test_nifti_saver.py, tests/test_handler_segmentation_saver.py and tests/test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py, and updated tests/test_handler_classification_saver.py to pass filename. Per instructions, no tests were run and flake8 was not run; line length and trailing whitespace were checked with grep. Nothing is committed.
